SELECT time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line, source_stream, netconn_domain, remote_ip, remote_port, process_guid, parent_process_guid
FROM audit_logs
WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-19 14:31:00' AND '2022-07-19 14:36:00'
  AND (
    (process_name LIKE '%regsvr32.exe%' OR pname LIKE '%regsvr32.exe%' OR command_line LIKE '%regsvr32.exe%')
    AND (access = 'connect' OR netconn_domain IS NOT NULL OR remote_ip IS NOT NULL OR source_stream LIKE '%dns%' OR source_stream LIKE '%browser%')
  )
ORDER BY time, pid
LIMIT 30;
